# Review Templates

## Daily (5–10 min)

```markdown
# Daily Review — YYYY-MM-DD

## Top 3
1.
2.
3.

## Inbox → zero
- processed: N

## Blockers / Waiting
-
```

## Weekly (30–45 min)

```markdown
# Weekly Review — YYYY-Www

## Wins
-

## Project next actions missing?
-

## Someday promotions / demotions
-

## System hygiene
- [ ] archive Done
- [ ] one trusted inbox only
```

## Tool-agnostic fields

每条任务最少有：`title`、`next_action`、`status`、`due?`、`project?`、`context?`。
